profile.headline: Salesforce Developer at Deloitte
profile.summary: I am a Senior at Booz Allen Hamilton working heavily with Appian and MySQL. I am looking to branch out and explore new opportunities in the cloud computing space.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
•	Lead a team by acting as a scrum master by holding daily scrums, sprint planning, and retrospectives to self-organize and operate independently.
•	Drive development of new stories and enhancements using Appian and MySQL on several different work streams concurrently as a key developer each sprint.
•	Refactor an existing application to improve user experience by modernizing user interfaces in compliance with best practices and address application performance issues by modifying high performance queries, streamlining business process flow, and optimizing tables and views using MySQL.
•	Mentor new developers to become familiar with the application and enforced proper technical design solutions and coding best practices.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
- Worked directly with clients to understand their current capabilities and pain points to develop and maintain BPM solutions by leveraging the Appian Platform.
- Developed technical solutions that leverage the Appian framework and MySQL Server and utilized GitHub and Appian plugins to implement a CI/CD pipeline to deliver new features to users.
- Improved application performance by creating stored procedures and optimizing views to offer better user experience.

positions.title: Facilitator Intern
positions.description:
- Assisted law enforcement professionals to navigate through software tools that were developed to fight against human trafficking. 
- Ran usability tests to determine the ease of use and accessibility of the software tools. 
- Analyzed other effectiveness measures associated with the software tools and identified related issues to technical staff.

positions.title: Sterilization Technologist
positions.description:
- Established and maintained the organization of surgical equipment for the sterile processing department used by surgeons in the OR.
- Performed data entry for new equipment and worked with vendors to maintain specialized sets for surgeries.
- Verified physical inventory against an online tracking system.
- Identified and escalated issues and risks that potentially impeded scheduled surgeries.
